metrics.market_cap_basis: rough_screen historical signal: 2024-08-22 close HK$2.73 times estimated shares, converted from CNY back to HKD using input HKD/CNY rate

cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Annual report only discloses group cash, not parent/HK/PRC split; cash is held by operating group entities and must support manufacturing working capital.
cash_breakdown.reason: Included as funds asset, but with PRC subsidiary and operating cash uncertainty reflected numerically.

cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Manufacturing business still needs liquidity for payroll, material purchases and working-capital volatility; reserve approximates about 1.3 months of 2024 revenue.
cash_breakdown.reason: Deducted after asset haircuts as cash that cannot be stripped without affecting ongoing operations.

cash_breakdown.item: Nantong Jianghai disposal net proceeds, post-period completion
cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: HKEX completion announcement confirms approximately HK$2.2bn net proceeds, but proceeds arise from PRC share disposal and may face capital allocation, tax, FX and distribution friction.
cash_breakdown.reason: Treated as detachable investment realisation proceeds rather than operating asset; 10% haircut retains friction and timing conservatism.

cash_breakdown.item: financial assets at FVTPL - PRC unlisted strategic investments
cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Non-listed equity and limited partnership interests, held for long-term strategic purposes, have uncertain exit route and valuation.
cash_breakdown.reason: Included at low haircut factor under non-listed investment asset rule; not treated as cash.

cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Debt investments are Caa3 speculative-risk bonds, impaired and extended to 2028/2029.
cash_breakdown.reason: Only a small recovery value is credited because cash-like quality is poor.

cash_breakdown.item: bank borrowings - unsecured, due within one year
cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Interest-bearing bank debt is deducted at 100%.
cash_breakdown.reason: Financing debt must be repaid or assumed by a control buyer.

cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Small ordinary operating lease liabilities are continuing-operation costs and are reflected in profit/cash-flow quality rather than mechanically deducted from detachable cash.
cash_breakdown.reason: Checked but not included as a separate debt deduction in the main net cash bridge.

cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Annual report states no significant charges or pledges on assets as at 31 March 2024; no separate restricted cash balance was disclosed.
cash_breakdown.reason: No additional restricted cash deduction beyond the operating cash reserve.

profit_quality.assessment: Reported parent net profit of HK$176.764m is not the denominator. It includes HK$151.886m share of associates and other investment items. The relevant operating base is the Displays segment: 2024 segment profit was HK$54.956m, revenue fell sharply, and 2024 free cash after capex was supported by working-capital release.
adjustments: Exclude share of associates of HK$151.886m from sustainable operating cash profit because it is equity-accounted investment profit, not display-business cash earnings.
Use display-business operating economics rather than reported consolidated net profit.
Use 2024 lower revenue and segment profit as anchor instead of the stronger 2023 year.
Treat capex need as meaningful: 2022-2024 capex plus equipment prepayments were approximately HK$53.199m, HK$33.806m and HK$60.225m.

Apply 0.55 profit haircut because cash generation is positive but cyclicality, revenue decline, under-utilisation and working-capital swings make distributable cash materially below accounting profit.
profit_quality.cashflow_support: OCF/capex/free cash after capex for 2022-2024: HK$32.270m / HK$53.199m / -HK$20.929m; HK$239.580m / HK$33.806m / HK$205.774m; HK$142.173m / HK$60.225m / HK$81.948m. 2024 OCF benefited from inventory and receivables reduction.
profit_quality.haircut_reason: The displays business still earns operating profit, but revenue declined 29.4%, gross margin fell to 15.4%, and OCF includes working-capital release; a mid-low conversion haircut is required.
profit_quality.cash_conversion_assessment: Positive but volatile; 2024 cash flow overstates steady-state cash profit because inventories and receivables fell.
profit_quality.maintenance_capex_assessment: No precise maintenance capex split; HK$45m is used as a conservative normalised maintenance/reinvestment estimate against recent capex of HK$53.199m, HK$33.806m and HK$60.225m.
profit_quality.working_capital_assessment: Working capital released cash in 2024 after revenue contraction; no recurring release is assumed.

evidence.note: Input market cap was CNY 2,340,872,714.65 using HKD/CNY 0.9157379866; converted to HKD for report metrics.

evidence.source: 2023/24 annual report, statement of financial position and note 24, pages 46 and 102
evidence.note: HK$152.867m, converted from HK$'000 to HKD.
HK$31.735m unsecured bank borrowings due within one year.
Post-period completion evidence; used because the asset was already held for sale at the annual report date.
Used to anchor sustainable operating cash profit.

evidence.value: 2024 OCF HK$142.173m; capex and equipment prepayment HK$60.225m
evidence.source: 2023/24 annual report, consolidated statement of cash flows, pages 51-52
evidence.note: Converted from HK$'000 to HKD in calculations.

limitations: The run uses the rough-screen historical market cap signal around 2024-08-22, not a live market cap on 2026-07-22.
The requested period is 2023-12-31, while the company's actual annual report period ends 2024-03-31.
Cash is not split by parent company, Hong Kong subsidiaries and PRC operating subsidiaries, so cash has a 0.70 haircut and a separate HK$100m operating cash reserve.
Nantong Jianghai disposal proceeds are post-period evidence; the 2024 annual report itself only classified the relevant interest as held for sale.
Maintenance capex is estimated because the annual report does not split maintenance and growth capex.
